reviewItem.question: Does "If you have not configured `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store`,`-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` or their corresponding YAML setting before, no changes are required as…" mean a change to cli-flag:loki|name=-boltdb.shipper.shared-store|component=shipper (removed)?

proposed.statement: The cli-flags -boltdb.shipper.shared-store and -tsdb.shipper.shared-store, and their corresponding YAML configuration keys, have been removed and are no longer honored in Loki 3.0.0; environments that had not configured these settings are unaffected.
